content.value: The following figure shows a portion of power system in a single line diagram. Find (12) out the time of operation of relays R<sub>1</sub> and R<sub>2</sub> for a fault immediately after relaying point R<sub>2</sub>. Relay R<sub>1</sub> is voltage monitored overcurrent relay, the PS of which reduces to 40% of the set value if voltage collapses below 70% of the rated voltages.
